description: UNOSAT and partner damage assessments: Pakistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: EQ20190924PAK This map illustrates satellite based building damage assessment in New Mirpur City, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan affected by the 5.6 magnitude Mirpur earthquake of the 24th of September 2019 with an epicenter SE of New Mipur City. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal lists 7 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
